paragraphs: I'm applying for the Sustainability Intern role on NYPA's Sustainability Team. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. Most of my MBA work has been on the clean energy side, and I want to see how a utility the size of NYPA puts sustainability into its day-to-day operations, including its supply chain.

For an MBA project I built financial models for a 35.4 MW Illinois solar portfolio and compared sustainability-linked loan and green loan plus ABS structures. At Thomson Reuters I worked cross-functionally with finance teams on monthly P&L forecasting and close for the ANZ region, and ran reconciliations with 85%+ accuracy. At Lenovo I built dashboards and scenario analyses for leadership.

The internship covers research, analysis and work with suppliers and employees. I'm comfortable with the research and the numbers in Excel and PowerPoint, and I'm used to working with teams across functions and time zones. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the summer program.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) student at Fordham Gabelli and I'm applying for NYPA's Sustainability internship. My MBA work has focused on clean energy finance, including modeling a 35.4 MW solar portfolio and comparing sustainability-linked and green loan structures. I'd love to hear what the team is focused on this year. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
